title: Implement an RFC4180-flavoured CSV parser and serializer

prompt.zh: 请按 README.md 中的规格实现 csv.mjs 里的 parseCsv 和 stringifyCsv。不要修改 README.md、package.json 或已有测试，不要引入第三方依赖。完成后运行 `npm test` 确认现有测试通过。注意：评分会运行未公开的边界情况测试（BOM、空行、引号转义的各个角落、错误处理、往返一致性）。
prompt.en: Implement parseCsv and stringifyCsv in csv.mjs as specified in README.md. Do not modify README.md, package.json or the existing tests, and do not add third-party dependencies. Run `npm test` afterwards to confirm the existing tests pass. Scoring also runs hidden edge-case tests (BOM, empty lines, every quoting corner, error handling, round-tripping).
